brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
Leaderboard is not working correctly @buildthis.bisks.net and make it so you can vote for yourself

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@fromthewestmeadow.com: Ayo build a Bluesky Social Credit leaderboard. Sign in with Bluesky OAuth, enter any handle, then give that person +1 or -1. Their score persists globally.
note: saw the thread flip-flopped on self-voting and already landed "no self-voting" today, so left that as-is. real leaderboard bug: it ranked everyone who'd ever *cast* a vote, not just people who'd *received* one — fixed to only rank/count accounts with actual votes on them.
